answer: Equivocation-proof bond: each identity stakes 70 credits for one willow plot by a lagoon, filing one signed lagoon reading per epoch. A mirror ledger lists each reading by the gauge table for replay. Two readings from one key, or one reading for two plots, burns both. Survey k costs 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes sink 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-mirror ring fails: shared keys show. An honest agent pays 35 once, bond kept.
